notes: OSM-derived route with an explicitly image-guided correction of the lower outer bend. Ten native-image centre controls replace the old lower chicane that crosses the visible curb/apron. The correction follows pinned June2024 PNOA orthophotography, not operator diagram coordinates. Operator illustration identifies the route configuration only. Both OSM and PNOA attribution are retained. Source configuration, travel direction and georeferencing remain draft; no nominal dimensions, timing position or banking are fitted.
